title: AnalysisFifo — lock-free SPSC, multi-channel data transport
description:
Implement Source/Analysis/AnalysisFifo as the lock-free single-producer single-consumer transport from audio thread to analysis/message thread.

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/CHUGGATE_SPEC.md §20 (Visual Diagnostic System), §28.1–28.2 (audio-thread rules, AbstractFifo analysis transport: drop frames, never block audio)
- Existing Source/DSP/* prepare/reset patterns (fixed storage, no audio-thread alloc)
- juce::AbstractFifo usage conventions in the JUCE submodule if needed

Implement AnalysisFifo.h/.cpp:
- Lock-free SPSC FIFO built on juce::AbstractFifo (or equivalent fixed-capacity ring with AbstractFifo as the free/used counter).
- Payload carries a single AnalysisFrame (or equivalent POD/trivial struct) bundling fields needed by phase-H consumers: key envelope, main envelope, open/close thresholds, noise-floor estimate, gate state enum/int, output gain, transient flag/strength, sustain confidence, optional alignment/noise snapshot indices or small fixed arrays.
- Multi-channel-aware capacity: size for N channels of any per-channel slots in the frame plus control metadata; capacity chosen at prepare() and never resized on the audio path.
- Audio-thread API: tryPush(frame) / write — non-blocking; if full, skip/drop the frame (count drops via atomic if useful) and return false; never wait/block.
- Analysis/message-thread API: tryPop(frame) / read — non-blocking drain.
- QualityMode enum (Off, Live, Studio, Diagnose) owned or declared here (or a tiny shared AnalysisTypes header inside AnalysisFifo.h) so producers can gate how often to push (Live skips frames more aggressively than Studio/Diagnose; Off never pushes).
- prepare(maxFrames, numChannels) / reset(); fixed HeapBlock/std::array storage sized in prepare only.
- No mutex, no logging from the push path, no heap allocation after prepare.

Do NOT implement PerformanceHistory, NoiseFingerprint, AlignmentScopeData, integrity analyzers, PluginProcessor wiring, CMakeLists, or tests.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.
acceptance_criteria: AnalysisFifo uses juce::AbstractFifo (or documented equivalent) for lock-free SPSC free/used accounting
tryPush is non-blocking and drops frames when full rather than blocking the producer
tryPop is non-blocking and returns false when empty
QualityMode enum includes Off, Live, Studio, Diagnose
Storage capacity is fixed in prepare with no heap allocation on the push path after prepare
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: allocate or take mutexes on the audio/push path after prepare

allowed: define POD AnalysisFrame with fixed-size arrays for multi-channel scalars
place QualityMode in AnalysisFifo.h for shared use by later tasks
use juce::AbstractFifo + HeapBlock preallocated in prepare
implement skip-frame policy via full-FIFO drop and/or quality-based subsample
forbidden: implement PerformanceHistory ring buffer or integrity metrics inside AnalysisFifo
block or spin-wait on full FIFO from the producer path
